bind_address.description: IP address the qnetd service binds to (e.g., '192.168.1.10' or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port on which qnetd listens for incoming cluster member connections.

tls_dir.description: Directory containing qnetd TLS certificates, private keys, and CRLs.

tls_log_level.description: Verbosity of TLS-related logging. Accepts debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

tls_algorithm.description: Cipher algorithm used for TLS key exchange or data encryption (must match cluster settings).

tls_client_auth.description: Whether to require client certificates for authentication (recommended for production).

tls_ciphers.description: Ordered list of allowed TLS cipher suites. Empty list uses defaults.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections accepted by qnetd.

tls_handshake_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for TLS handshake to complete before aborting connection.

tls_log_file.description: Path to file for TLS logs (if not specified, logs go to syslog).

tls_verify_depth.description: Maximum depth of certificate chain verification (higher allows deeper intermediate CA hierarchies).

tls_session_cache.description: Whether to cache TLS sessions to speed up reconnections (recommended).

tls_log_certificate_errors.description: Log detailed certificate validation errors (useful for debugging certificate mismatches).
